title: Sometimes I get to go on lakes and rivers.
content: I’m on a boat or inner tube, on a lake that feeds into a river. So there is slow currents on the lake, sometimes we get stuck on the wrong lake and we see the weather is turning or we can’t get back to shore. I always know how to get there, but it’s not working out. Sometimes we get sucked into the river. The river is dirty for some reason and has lots of bugs. If I get to the right spot we get to bounce around like we have almost no gravity. Not like flying, but pretty close.
